_note: Every string a reader sees. {placeholders} are filled by the core; TONE.md governs the wording, GLOSSARY.md the terms.
title: PDF Signature Adder
tagline: Sign a PDF on your iPad or laptop with a drawn or pasted signature, and save the signed copy.
start_text: Choose a PDF, or drop one on this page. Then draw or paste your signature, place it, and save a signed copy.
privacy_note: Your PDF and your signature stay in this browser tab. Nothing is uploaded, and nothing is kept after you close the tab.
drop_hint: Drop a PDF or a signature image here
status_ready: Add a signature, then tap or click the page where it goes.
status_placing: Tap or click the page where the signature goes. Its bottom edge lands where you tap.
status_selected: Drag to move it. Drag a corner to resize it. Arrow keys nudge it; hold Shift for bigger steps.
pad_hint: Sign above the line with a Pencil, a finger or the mouse
paste_hint: Copy a picture of your signature, then paste it here with the button, or with ⌘V or Ctrl+V.
open_image_hint: Choose a PNG, JPEG or SVG of your signature. A photo of ink on white paper works too.
clear_paper: Make the paper behind it transparent
saved_note: The original's text, links and form fields are unchanged; the signatures are added after them.
already_signed: This PDF already holds a digital signature. Readers such as Acrobat will show that the file changed after that signature was made.
refuse_not_pdf: This file is not a PDF. Choose a file whose name ends in .pdf.
refuse_damaged: This PDF is damaged ({detail}), so a signed copy could be damaged too. Open it in Preview or another reader, save a new copy, and open that.
refuse_encrypted: This PDF is locked with a password or with editing permissions, so it cannot be changed here. Print it to a new PDF first, then open that.
refuse_certified: This PDF is certified against any change, so adding a signature would break the certification. Ask the sender for a copy that allows signing.
refuse_no_pages: This PDF has no pages to sign.
refuse_unsupported: This PDF uses something the tool does not read ({detail}). Save a new copy from Preview or another reader, then open that.
picture_blank: No ink was found in that picture. Try a darker signature, or switch off "Make the paper behind it transparent".
picture_unreadable: That picture could not be read. Try a PNG, JPEG or SVG.
picture_too_large: That picture is larger than the tool takes. Try a smaller copy.
clipboard_empty: There is no picture on the clipboard. Copy one first, then paste.
clipboard_refused: The browser did not allow reading the clipboard. Press ⌘V or Ctrl+V instead.
nothing_placed: Place a signature on a page before saving.
save_failed: The signed copy did not pass its own check ({detail}), so it is not offered. The original is unchanged.
